words.sense: Unable or unlikely to cause harm, offense, or damage.
misconceptions: Anything harmless must involve innocence or an accusation.

words.sense: Not responsible for wrongdoing, or acting without harmful intention.
misconceptions: An accident that causes damage cannot be innocent.

semantic_axes.description: Whether the focus is lack of harmful effect or absence of guilt or harmful intent.

edges.boundary_rule: Innocuous means causing no harm; innocent means not culpable or not intending harm, even if harm occurs.
clues_b: accidental harm with no bad intention

misconceptions.M1: Anything harmless must involve innocence or an accusation.
misconceptions.M2: An accident that causes damage cannot be innocent.
misconceptions.M3: A person’s intent and an action’s effect mean the same thing.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Noor’s message?

beats.text: Noor posts a weather emoji and a reminder to bring umbrellas; nobody in the chat objects or feels singled out.
beats.decisive_clue: message causes no offense or harm
beats.reason: The situation shows message causes no offense or harm, which points to innocuous.

beats.text: The message neither reveals private details nor asks anyone for money.
beats.decisive_clue: message has no apparent harmful effect or risky demand
beats.reason: The issue is the message’s harmless character, not anyone’s guilt.

chains.feedback_short: Message has no apparent harmful effect or risky demand: innocuous fits better.
chains.feedback_deep: Innocuous means causing no harm; innocent means not culpable or not intending harm, even if harm occurs. Here, the issue is the message’s harmless character, not anyone’s guilt.
chains.contrast_rule: Innocuous does no harm; innocent bears no blame.

hints.attention: Consider what the message could do to readers.
hints.axis: Whether the focus is lack of harmful effect or absence of guilt or harmful intent.
hints.contrast: Innocuous does no harm; innocent bears no blame.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Elias’s role in the missing-ball incident?

beats.text: Elias was blamed for hiding the team’s ball, but a recording shows he left before it went missing.
beats.decisive_clue: evidence excludes Elias from the alleged act
beats.reason: The situation shows evidence excludes Elias from the alleged act, which points to innocent.

beats.text: The ball later turns up inside a storage box he had not opened.
beats.decisive_clue: the later discovery further excludes his responsibility
beats.reason: The evidence concerns whether Elias did anything wrong, not whether an object is safe.

chains.contrast_rule: Innocuous does no harm; innocent bears no blame.
